question: Can moving the first complete validation outside derived_clock::with_sealed change admission of historical FrozenAudioLayout or contexts when current.derived_clocks is empty?
conclusion: No reachable SEALED-sensitive historical validation path was found. The existing empty-current-derived-clock guard suffices for this specific difference. No preservation patch is required.
evidence: Exhaustive rg over crates/deadpan-core/src for SEALED, sealed_active, require_integral_clocks and with_sealed found TLS reads only in derived_clock::require_integral_clocks, command::dispatch/command application and insert_time::occurrence::target resolution. The latter two operations are not invoked by complete document validation.

ProjectDocument::durations_shared and durations share require_integral_clocks. Its first disjunct returns success whenever current.derived_clocks is empty, independently of SEALED. Complete validation then calls the same validated_with_context_limits implementation.

Historical FrozenAudioLayout::require_integral_clocks in audio_reference/exact_clock.rs is a separate method. It checks only that the historical layout derived_clocks map is empty and does not consult SEALED. AudioContext::validate calls precisely this FrozenAudioLayout method after layout.validate, so a historical exact-clock context is rejected identically inside or outside SEALED.

FrozenAudioLayout::validate calls build_index, which validates the frozen recipe graph then index_exact_clocks. Both operate on FrozenAudioLayout data. Exact-clock validation and require_follow_speed_clocks do not read SEALED or reconstruct a historical ProjectDocument.

AudioBindingState::validation_work validates retained historical layouts and calls require_follow_speed_clocks, independently of SEALED. validate_for_after may capture_structural(document) for live sound-clock comparison, but this capture receives the same current ProjectDocument. It uses recipe_structural_durations and effective_durations directly and does not turn historical layouts into ProjectDocuments.

Picture context validation inspects retained picture transforms/canvases, with no SEALED read, duration query or ProjectDocument reconstruction. AudioContext validates retained inputs, treatments and assets directly; its only ProjectDocument call during validate is static validate_asset.
limitations: Read-only source review only; no source edits, Cargo, tests, runtime or performance measurements.
